node.statement: Neumann-series discharge. Choose e_cov>0 below the compression-construction radius and with C_cov e_cov<1. For e<=e_cov, node #0 makes T=alpha_1 beta satisfy ||I_A-T||<1, so T^{-1}=sum_{r>=0}(I_A-T)^r exists as a bounded operator on the complete space A. For every Y in A, Y=T(T^{-1}Y)=alpha_1(beta(T^{-1}Y)); hence alpha_1 is onto. This proves node 1.5 without assuming directness of the target corner sum.
